layout.spacing_scale: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) for containers, dense tight gaps (gap-4) for data grids.
layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Dense). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col subgrid for tables.
layout.alignment: Left-aligned for all dense content, tables, and forms. Center only for empty states or AI processing loaders.

components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, 1px right border border-slate-200. Monochrome text, active state has font-medium and black text. Icons: Phosphor.
components.cards: Flat solid background, no shadow, 1px solid border-slate-200, rounded-none or rounded-sm max 4px. Hover: subtle shadow-sm.
components.tables: Dense Shadcn tables. Zebra striping on hover, sticky header. Verifactu status as minimalist badges.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm corners. Primary buttons are solid Blue/Black. Secondary buttons are outlined.
components.pdf_uploader: Dashed border area with Phosphor upload icon. When processing, use a monospace font loader 'Extrayendo datos AI...'

motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for table rows or dashboard widgets.
motion.ai_extraction: Scanning line animation over the PDF preview, skeleton loaders for extracted fields until confirmed.

login_background.description: Modern office architecture, used for the left/right split panel on the login/auth screen.

empty_state_team.description: Professional team, can be used in onboarding or empty states for 'Add your first supplier'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text passes WCAG AA. Buttons text must be white against primary colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='upload-pdf-button', data-testid='sidebar-clientes').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a sidebar layout with navigation for Dashboard, Clientes, Proveedores, Pedidos, Albaranes, Facturas Emitidas, Facturas Recibidas.
Implement the 'Control Room' dense grid for the Dashboard showing KPIs (Facturación, Pendientes, etc.).
For the AI PDF upload flow (in Facturas Recibidas / Albaranes), create a split-screen or modal: PDF preview on one side, extracted data form on the other for review.
Use Shadcn UI for tables, dialogs, forms, and dropdowns. Customize them to remove heavy shadows and large border radii.
Ensure the UI is entirely in Spanish as requested.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Do NOT use Inter.
Include data-testid attributes on all critical UI elements for testing.
